result.title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
result.summary: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues. Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth. We present WaveView, which injects the warped source into the phase of the initial noise of a pretrained generator. The Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT) allows local and anisotropic phase injection. The generator is thus constrained less in disoccluded regions and along the epipolar line. WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead. On the DL3DV benchmark, it outperforms all baselines in every overlap bin. In the hardest bin, it gains 0.84 dB PSNR on the covisible region over MetaView, which shares its generator, while running 2.1 times faster. For dynamic NVS, fine-tuning AnyView with the same noise raises its zero-shot PSNR on AnyViewBench from 11.58 to 12.35 dB.

AI.brief_summary: WaveView 研究生成式新视角合成，用 DT-CWPT 把 warp 后的源图以局部、各向异性的方式注入预训练扩散模型初始噪声的相位，从而在不改架构、几乎不增开销的情况下约束生成布局。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把几何对齐的视觉证据写入初始 latent 的相位/频率结构而非显式条件，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据如何注入并被 latent 状态保留」提供借鉴线索，但该文面向渲染保真而非推理，迁移价值需核查。
